startup_clear.valid_logic5_region: TPS3890 is specified for VDD >= 1.5 V; SN74HCS74 operation begins at VCC >= 2 V. In that latch operating range, the TPS3890s hold shared rails_ok low until monitored logic5/aux rails cross their thresholds and release timing completes, keeping CLR2 asserted regardless of TPS3431 below-POR ENOUT/WDO state.
startup_clear.electrical_topology: WDO and ENOUT share only their permitted open-drain pull-up node. rails_ok is a separate AND input, so there is no push-pull/open-drain contention. AND output has 100 nF local bypass and 10 kohm pulldown.
startup_clear.limit: Below TPS3890 VDD=1.5 V, no output/reset-state guarantee is claimed. The 10 kohm output pulldown biases the AND output but does not guarantee behavior of unpowered silicon. Full partial-power ramp and gate-driver default-off behavior in that interval remain unverified.
